name: Kedra AI Index
summary: Shopify app that checks whether ChatGPT, Gemini and other AI assistants recommend your store, ranks fixes, and publishes llms.txt and agents.md files.
best_for: Shopify store owners who want to see whether AI assistants recommend their products and want llms.txt and agents.md files kept up to date from the catalog
skip_if: you do not sell on Shopify, you want independent documentation before you install, or you want a tool we have tested ourselves
honest_knock: It is a young app, listed since April 2026, and we found no documentation for it outside the Shopify listing. It works only on Shopify, and the visibility results come from the vendor's own tests, which we could not check.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · Starter is $10 a month or $100 a year
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-11 on the Shopify App Store listing, US dollars) Kedra has a Free plan and three paid plans. Free covers an AI visibility check on 5 AI engines, 3 AI fixes drafted and applied for you, llms.txt and agents.md files, and visits from ChatGPT and other AI assistants for the last 30 days. Starter costs $10 a month or $100 a year and adds a weekly visibility check, 15 AI fixes a month and 90 days of AI traffic and sales analytics. Grow costs $25 a month or $216 a year and adds daily tracking in 1 market, 12 buyer questions on ChatGPT and Gemini, 40 AI fixes a month with a fix autopilot, and 5 AI blog posts a month. Pro costs $79 a month or $708 a year and adds tracking in 3 markets, 30 buyer questions, unlimited AI fixes and 15 blog posts a month. The listing shows a 10-day free trial on Starter and Grow. Charges run through your Shopify bill, and we did not open the install screen, so any tax or currency conversion is not known. An earlier reading on 18 October 2026 also showed a Scale plan at $199 a month; it is not on the listing now.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 16 November 2026 the session tested Kedra AI Index on the Free plan of a Shopify development store: the guide, publishing the AI files, the AI visibility audit, the plan screens up to the Shopify approval screen and the uninstall dialog. Nothing was approved, paid or uninstalled. Step 3, Turn on AI discovery, has three switches: Remove your storefront password, Turn on AI crawler tracking and Publish your AI files, the last one described as putting agents.md and llms.txt on the live storefront. Publish now was clicked; after about 10 seconds the line read Done and the counter 1 of 3 activated. Step 4 then showed an AI visibility score of 39 / 100, labelled Not AI-ready and Partial, with 6 to fix and 3 to improve: Product data 44%, Crawler access 40% and Trust and policies 29%. AI shopping agents and Live crawler check read Not measured with Password on, and a note said 2 checks that need a public storefront were skipped. The AI Visibility page shows 3 of 3 free fixes, Audited 14 products, checked 1 minute ago, Live products only; the biggest win is Description, 14 of 14 products need a fuller description; the most common gaps are Barcode/GTIN 14 of 14, Description 13 of 14 and SEO description 13 of 14; the 14 products split into 0 Excellent, 0 Good, 4 Needs work and 10 Not AI-ready, with the lowest scores Bundle Product #1 at 31, The Compare at Price Snowboard at 36 and Gift Card at 41. Bulk fix and Autopilot (Off, Available on Grow) are visible. The app home showed AI tracking Inactive and Get started 1/3 completed. Timing, approximate tester observations: install at about 14:38, files published and the score visible at about 14:39, so about 1 to 2 minutes and about 7 clicks. Whether llms.txt and agents.md really stand on the storefront was not verified, because the store has a password that was not removed. Uninstall: Settings, Apps, the row for the app, then Uninstall opened a dialog saying that data managed by the app will be deleted and that a request goes to the developer within 48 hours to delete personal customer information, with a reason list and a feedback box; it was cancelled. Not tested: a real check of which AI assistants name the brand, removing the storefront password, AI crawler tracking in the theme editor, the 3 free fixes, Bulk fix, Autopilot, paid plans and yearly prices. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The store password made the live crawler and AI shopping agent checks read Not measured, so the audit score of 39 / 100 covers only what could be read without a public storefront.
